svg.title: prideQC overview: raw spectra to QC evidence to refined SDRF
svg.desc: Raw mzML or vendor RAW files are read once per file by a streaming QC engine that computes scan, acquisition, mass-error precision, diagnostic and recurrent mass-shift evidence. Structured outputs feed pmultiqc reporting and a confidence-gated cohort synthesis that refines and validates SDRF metadata.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: prideQC: from raw spectra to QC evidence to refined metadata

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Quality-control metrics and technical evidence are computed directly from the raw data; sufficiently supported evidence can refine SDRF metadata.

svg.text: Reporting and refinement both start from the same per-file evidence. pmultiqc displays results; prideQC computes them.
